_doc: Machine-readable companion to tests/collection-contract.md (SD-LEO-INFRA-REPO-HYGIENE-PATH-001, FR-3). vitest.config.js's SHARED_EXCLUDE is BUILT FROM this file's `patterns` array (via loadCollectionContractExclude()) rather than a hand-maintained inline literal. Each entry's `pattern` is the exact glob string previously hardcoded in vitest.config.js -- copied byte-for-byte, not rewritten, so this refactor changes WHERE the list lives, never WHAT it excludes. `gitignore_backed: true` marks an entry that corresponds to an actual gitignored-copy-directory incident (the class FR-3 exists to guard against); `gitignore_backed: false` marks an entry excluded for an unrelated reason (source-tree scoping, spec-file routing, etc.) that happens to live in the same list.

Same anchoring rationale as lib/agents/** above.

SD-LEO-INFRA-TEST-ESTATE-HYGIENE-001: orphaned legacy test/ root, separately excluded by CI but not by a bare local `npm test` before this entry -- the local/CI divergence this SD's FR-3 exists to close a whole CLASS of.
Archived .test.js files import @playwright/test and crash a vitest run with 'Playwright Test did not expect test.describe()'.

Same class as .worktrees/** for a Claude-Code-specific worktree location.
Defensive exclusion for a literal 'PATH' directory name (environment-variable-name collision hazard on some tooling).

See vitest.config.js's own comment for the full incident writeup.
